import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int M = 1000000007;
    static final int mod = 998244353;
    static final int base = 1000000;
    static final int m = 6;
    static long N, pos;
    static int cnt_suf;
    static Mint[] sum = new Mint[m + 1];
    static Mint res = new Mint(0);
    static List<Integer>[] suf = new ArrayList[m + 1];

    static class Mint {
        int x;

        Mint(int _x) {
            this.x = _x;
        }

        public int get() {
            return x;
        }

        public static Mint add(Mint a, Mint b) {
            int x = a.x + b.x;
            return new Mint(x < M ? x : x - M);
        }

        public static Mint subtract(Mint a, Mint b) {
            int x = a.x - b.x;
            return new Mint(x < 0 ? x + M : x);
        }

        public static Mint multiply(Mint a, Mint b) {
            long res = (long) a.x * b.x % M;
            return new Mint((int) res);
        }

        public static Mint pw(Mint a, int x) {
            Mint res = new Mint(1);
            while (x > 0) {
                if ((x & 1) == 1) {
                    res = multiply(res, a);
                }
                a = multiply(a, a);
                x >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static void dfs0(int i, long n) {
        int x = (int) (((pos - n) % mod + mod) % mod);
        sum[i] = sum[i] == null ? new Mint(0) : sum[i];
        sum[i] = Mint.add(sum[i], new Mint(x));
        suf[i].add(x);
        if (i == m) return;
        for (int c = 0; c < 10; c++) {
            dfs0(i + 1, n * 10 + c);
        }
    }

    static void dfs1(long n) {
        if (n >= N) return;
        if ((n + 1) * base <= N && n * base * 10 >= N) {
            long p = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                Mint ns = new Mint(suf[i].size());
                int x = (int) (((pos - p * n) % mod + mod) % mod);
                int cnt = lowerBound(suf[i], mod - x);
                res = Mint.add(res, Mint.add(Mint.multiply(ns, new Mint(x)), sum[i]).subtract(new Mint((ns.get() - cnt) * M)));
                p *= 10;
            }
            pos += cnt_suf;
            return;
        }
        res = Mint.add(res, new Mint(((pos - n) % mod + mod) % mod));
        for (int c = 0; c < 10; c++) {
            dfs1(n * 10 + c);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        N += 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            sum[i] = new Mint(0);
            suf[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        pos = 0;
        dfs0(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            cnt_suf += suf[i].size();
            Collections.sort(suf[i]);
        }
        pos = 1;
        for (int c = 1; c < 10; c++) {
            dfs1(c);
        }
        System.out.println(res.get());
    }
}
